_doc: Proportion targets every Tabard body must meet (tools/blender/tb_measure.py checks the rest pose). Units: head height (crown to jaw) unless noted. Source: the owner's ChatGPT hero/heroine reference sheets (avatar-3d/fal/ref/male-original.jpg, female-original.jpg: ~7-7.5 heads tall, hands about one face long, fists at crotch height), loosened a little toward a chunky game read. fingertip_height = where the fingertips reach with the arm hanging straight, as a share of body height (real people ~0.37-0.40). bodies.<body>: per-body overrides. The woman's shoulder joints sit 1.21 head-heights apart (reference ~1.35+); widening needs the skeleton itself moved — parked, owner to decide (2026-11-22).
